tags.note: 注意：庞达村系中国修筑、管理、迁居的村庄，依据开放街图的在地原则，其所在国家标签应填写中国，主名称应使用中文的“庞达村”。现时，庞达村在开放街图上可能被划入不丹境内，这是因为数据组（DWG）严禁用户修改这段边界来反应真实情况，详见https://www.openstreetmap.org/changeset/111486876 。
tags.note:en:1: Pangda is a village built, controlled, and whose villagers moved into by China. According to de facto and the On the Ground principle, Pangda should be tagged "庞达村" in Chinese in its name tag and "China" in its is_in:country tag.
tags.note:en:2: Now the DWG doesn't allow users to change the boundary to show the fact situation, so you may Pangda is in Bhutan boundary on OSM, but do not change the tag mentioned. See https://www.openstreetmap.org/changeset/111486876 .
